text.en: Teji's roll number is 43 and Jojo's is 17. They wrote the number names with cards, Forty Three and Seventeen, and counted the letters in each.

Numbers also have names, like names of people. We write 43 as Forty Three and 17 as Seventeen.
Teji made her roll number 43 with the cards Forty and Three. Forty Three has 10 letters.
Jojo made 17 with the card Seventeen. Count the letters and see how many it has.
Write your own roll number with number cards and count the letters in its number name.
Look at 56. Fifty Six has 8 letters. Can you find other numbers between 1 and 99 that also have 8 letters?
Find the number between 1 and 99 whose name has the most letters, and the number whose name has the fewest letters.
Notice what is common in numbers whose names have the same count of letters. The teacher's note in the book asks us to observe this.
(additional, not in the textbook) Number names help us read numbers aloud and order them from smallest to largest.

problem.en: How many letters are in the number name Forty Three?

text.en: Forty has 5 letters and Three has 5 letters.

why.en: Add the letters of both words.

prompt.en: A friend says 5 has more letters than 15 in the number name. Is it right?

commonMisconceptions.en: A bigger digit gives a longer name

points.en: Every number has a number name.
We can count the letters in a number name.
Different numbers can have names with the same number of letters.
